name: Preview

standout.headline: You’re one of only 4 people born in April

message:
Preview, we want you to know how much this year meant to us.

From the very first planning meeting to the last shift on the last day, you showed up in ways that made this whole thing work. There were early mornings none of us wanted, schedule changes that came in at the worst possible time, and a dozen small fires that got put out before anyone else even noticed they'd started. A lot of that was you.

We know it wasn't glamorous. Most of what kept RecWeek and Welcome Week running was quiet, unremarkable work, the kind nobody claps for. But we saw it, and we're not going to let it go unsaid: thank you for every hour, every favor, and every time you said yes when it would have been easier to say no.

Here's to whatever we build next, with you in it.
